name: oh-my-pi-chater
displayName: PI Buddy — omp & pi Agent with Voice Pair Programmer
description: Unofficial VS Code GUI for the omp (Oh My Pi) and pi coding agents, plus a voice AI pair-programming partner that talks with you, points at code, edits and debugs alongside you, or hands work to the agent.

PI Buddy: Voice Agent — Show Bot View

enumDescriptions: Use omp (Oh My Pi) when found, otherwise pi
Oh My Pi: standalone binary, state in ~/.omp/agent
pi: Node CLI, state in ~/.pi/agent
oh-my-pi-chater.backend.description: Default agent CLI family to run in RPC mode. Switching backend in the chat or settings panel applies only to the current workspace window and overrides this default there. Reload the window after changing.

oh-my-pi-chater.cliPath.description: Path to the omp or pi executable (default: auto-detect from PATH). With backend "auto", a file named omp* selects omp.

oh-my-pi-chater.nodePath.description: pi backend only: Node.js binary used to run pi (default: node next to pi on PATH). Set this if native tools (memory_search) fail with NODE_MODULE_VERSION errors.

oh-my-pi-chater.thinkingLevel.description: Default thinking level for Pi agent responses

enumDescriptions: File changes and commands wait for your approval in the chat; reading and searching run freely.
File edits run without asking; commands and deleting or moving files wait for your approval.
Read-only: agents may only read and search, and propose a plan. On pi this is pi's own plan mode.
Agents edit, delete files and run commands without asking.
oh-my-pi-chater.defaultPermissionLevel.description: Permission mode of new chat tabs until you pick one in the menu next to the model chip under the chat input: new tabs then start in the last mode picked in this workspace, and a reopened conversation keeps its own. Changing this setting makes new tabs use it again. Applies to the worker agent and the voice agent.

oh-my-pi-chater.allowedTools.description: Manual and Edit automatically: tool names (e.g. bash) that run without asking. Plan still blocks them.

oh-my-pi-chater.autoApproveTools.description: Legacy: when defaultPermissionLevel is not set, true starts new tabs in Auto.

oh-my-pi-chater.showAllModels.description: List every model the agent reports, including providers configured only via env vars or models.json/models.yml. Off: only providers you signed in to with /login (pi auth.json / omp credential store).

oh-my-pi-chater.favoriteModels.description: Starred models (`provider/id`) offered by the model chip under the chat input. Star or unstar models with the ☆ button in the full model picker (switch button of the model status line at the top of the chat, or /model).

oh-my-pi-chater.contextUsageWarningThres.description: Show a warning when context usage exceeds this percentage of the context window

oh-my-pi-chater.promptRecommendedPackage.description: When Pi CLI sync is on, prompt to install recommended Pi packages (~/.pi/agent) if they are missing.

oh-my-pi-chater.autoInstallRecommendedPa.description: Install recommended Pi packages automatically on startup without asking (requires network/npm).

enumDescriptions: Built-in: Moonshine (English) running locally in a separate process. Nothing to install; its models (about 350 MB with the built-in voice) download on first use.
Custom: the OpenAI-compatible server at voice.sttUrl.
oh-my-pi-chater.voice.sttEngine.markdownDescription: Voice input and voice mode: speech-to-text engine. Unset, it is `custom` when `#oh-my-pi-chater.voice.sttUrl#` is set, else `builtin`.

oh-my-pi-chater.voice.sttUrl.markdownDescription: Voice input with the custom engine: OpenAI-compatible speech-to-text endpoint, e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:8010/v1` (speaches / faster-whisper-server) or `https://api.openai.com/v1`. A bare host gets `/v1`; `/audio/transcriptions` is appended. Empty disables recording.

oh-my-pi-chater.voice.sttModel.description: Voice input with the custom engine: transcription model id. Empty uses the first model the server lists at /models.

oh-my-pi-chater.voice.language.description: Voice input: ISO-639-1 language hint (zh, en, …). Empty lets the model detect it per utterance.

oh-my-pi-chater.voice.vadConfidence.description: Voice input: Silero VAD speech probability threshold. Lower it (e.g. 0.35) if quiet speech is missed; raise it if background noise gets transcribed.

oh-my-pi-chater.voice.vadStopSecs.description: Voice input: pause (seconds) that ends an utterance and sends it to speech-to-text.

oh-my-pi-chater.voice.voiceprint.enabled.markdownDescription: Voice input and voice mode take only your voice: each utterance is compared with the voiceprint you record in Settings → Voice (kept in extension storage, not here), and someone else's is dropped. Runs on the built-in voice engine (a ~28 MB speaker model), whatever speech-to-text you use. Recording a voiceprint turns this on.

oh-my-pi-chater.voice.voiceprint.thresho.description: Voiceprint: similarity (0–1) an utterance needs to count as your voice. Raise it if other voices get through; lower it if yours is dropped. The voiceprint Test in Settings → Voice shows the similarity of each utterance.

enumDescriptions: Check utterances under 1 second against a threshold 0.1 higher: they carry little voice, so a short shout from someone else is less likely to pass (short words of yours are dropped more often).
Let utterances under 1 second through unchecked.
oh-my-pi-chater.voice.voiceprint.shortSp.description: Voiceprint: how utterances under 1 second are judged.

oh-my-pi-chater.voice.denoise.description: Voice input and voice mode: take the background noise out of each utterance (GTCRN on the built-in voice engine, ~0.5 MB) before speech-to-text and the voiceprint check. Adds a little delay.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.model.description: Voice agent: model (provider/id) for the voice conversation, on the active backend (omp or pi). Empty uses the current chat tab's model when the voice agent starts. Takes effect after Voice Agent — Stop.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.thinking.description: Voice agent: thinking level. Off keeps spoken replies fast. Takes effect after Voice Agent — Stop.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.skills.description: Voice agent: names of the installed skills it loads (Settings → Voice), next to its built-in show-me and grilling skills, which are always loaded. Empty loads only the built-ins. omp loads them by name, pi by their SKILL.md files. Takes effect after Voice Agent — Stop.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.extraPrompt.markdownDescription: Voice agent: extra instructions appended to its built-in system prompt, under "Additional instructions from the user:" (Settings → Voice → Voice agent → Instructions). Markdown is fine. Empty adds nothing. The built-in prompt itself cannot be edited. A change restarts a running voice agent's process between turns; the conversation carries on.

enumDescriptions: Plain and friendly: no mood changes, no jokes.
Its mood drifts from turn to turn, and about one reply in four invites a brief aside of a random kind: a pun, a cold joke, dry understatement and so on.
As occasional, with an aside invited in about one reply in three.
oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.humor.description: Voice agent: how much mood and humour its replies carry. The extension rolls the dice every turn, so jokes come at random and in varied kinds instead of every reply or never. Never next to an error, a question for you, an approval or a deletion, and never two replies running. The kind of humour follows the Instructions (voiceAgent.extraPrompt).

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.confirmBefore.description: Voice agent: a new task for an idle worker is only sent after you agree to the plan in a later message.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.followPi.description: Voice agent: follow Pi's focus. Following, the editor opens and scrolls to the code Pi talks about, reads or writes; typing in the editor stops following until you turn it on again. Set by the follow button next to Voice agent above the chat input, which remembers your choice here.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.discoverPrevi.description: Voice agent: let list_viewers and open_with also use preview commands from installed extensions, not only VS Code's built-in ones such as the Markdown preview. Off by default: many extensions' preview commands need their own arguments or state and may do nothing or never finish. Custom editors from installed extensions (e.g. draw.io) are always offered.

enumDescriptions: Only speak when spoken to, and about what the voice agent itself started: a request from a task it sent to the worker, and the outcome of its own approval cards.
Speak up when the worker needs an answer, fails or finishes, and when research comes back.
As important, plus progress updates while the worker is busy.
oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.narration.description: Voice agent: when it speaks up on its own about the current task.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.minProactiveG.description: Voice agent: quiet seconds after any reply before it announces finished work, research or progress. Worker questions and errors are announced right away.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.narrationInte.description: Voice agent: with narration "all", seconds without a reply before a progress update.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.turnStopSecs.description: Voice mode: seconds of silence that end your turn. Takes effect when voice mode starts.

enumDescriptions: Built-in: Piper (en_US lessac) running locally in a separate process, English only; tts.url, tts.model, tts.voice and tts.languageField are not used. Its model downloads on first use.
Custom: the OpenAI-compatible server at tts.url.
oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.tts.engine.markdownDescription: Voice mode: text-to-speech engine. Unset, it is `custom` when `#oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.tts.url#` is set, else `builtin`.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.tts.provider.markdownDeprecationMessage: Replaced by `#oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.tts.engine#` and `#oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.tts.languageField#`; moved there automatically when the extension starts.
oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.tts.provider.description: Voice mode: the text-to-speech setting before tts.engine. Still read (and moved to tts.engine) while tts.engine is unset.

enumDescriptions: Send no language: the server detects it, or the voice speaks one language.
Send language zh for sentences with Chinese, en otherwise (e.g. chatterbox-tts, which then reads mixed Chinese and English).
Speak Chinese runs with lang_code z and the rest in the voice's own language, each run its own request (e.g. Kokoro-FastAPI).
oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.tts.languageF.description: Voice mode, custom engine: how the server is told the language of what it reads.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.tts.url.description: Voice mode, custom engine: OpenAI-compatible text-to-speech base URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8881/v1. Takes effect when voice mode starts.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.tts.model.description: Voice mode, custom engine: text-to-speech model. Empty sends none and the server picks; Test in Settings → Voice lists the server's models to choose from.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.tts.voice.description: Voice mode, custom engine: text-to-speech voice. Empty sends none and the server picks.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.historySessio.description: Voice view: past voice conversations kept per workspace (one per task and voice mode run).

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.debugTranscri.description: Voice view: also show what each turn sent to the voice model and the updates it chose not to speak about (<silent/>). For troubleshooting.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.messageButton.markdownDescription: Voice view: read aloud and translate sentences in the Bot view and the chat (prompts, replies, Thought blocks, tool card text). Hold Alt to highlight the sentence under the pointer; Alt+click reads it aloud with the configured text-to-speech, Alt+right-click shows its translation into `#oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.translateTo#` in a floating panel (the text is sent to Google Translate). Alt+Shift does the same with the whole paragraph. Selecting text with the mouse shows Read aloud and Translate buttons for the selection. While text is read aloud, the sentence being read is highlighted; click the text to pause or resume, double-click a word to read on from there, click elsewhere or press Escape to stop.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.translateTo.markdownDescription: Voice view: the language Alt+right-click (or Translate on a selection) translates into (with `#oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.messageButtons#` on).

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.replayCacheSi.description: Voice view: how many messages' synthesized audio is kept in memory for reading sentences aloud (what voice mode spoke, and each sentence Alt+click synthesized); the oldest goes first. 0 keeps none.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.userName.description: Voice view: your name, shown on your turns in the Bot view. The voice agent is told it when it is not the default.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.userAvatar.markdownDescription: Voice view: your avatar in the Bot view. A preset (the default icons `preset:user` and `preset:robot`, or pixel art: `preset:uncle`, `preset:boy`, `preset:cat`, `preset:otaku`, `preset:woman`, `preset:gentleman`; also clickable in Settings → Voice), an emoji or up to two characters (e.g. `🦊`, `ZG`), or the path of a picture (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or SVG, under 2 MB; `~` is your home folder, a relative path starts at the workspace folder). Empty: the default icon.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.botName.description: Voice view: the voice agent's name, shown on its replies in the Bot view. It is told this name and answers to it when it is not the default.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.botAvatar.markdownDescription: Voice view: the voice agent's avatar in the Bot view, like `#oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.userAvatar#`. Empty: the robot.
